cases.title: Shell MAWP at corroded t = 0.5 in
Torispherical head, App. 1-4(d), L = 60 in, r = 3.6 in
Nozzle N1 required area A (NPS 8 Sch 80, SA-106-B in SA-516-70)
cases.method_difference: The reference library deducts the 12.5 % pipe undertolerance from tn and enlarges d accordingly (a conservative choice it documents). This library follows UG-16(d), which exempts UG-37/UG-40 reinforcement areas from the undertolerance. The benchmark is run with the reference convention to show the area formula agrees; the default convention is expected to give a smaller A (about 3.03 in2). The difference is reported, not adjusted away.
